thesis: The episode introduces Steve Mosley, head of alternative investments at the Alaska Permanent Fund, who leads a team focused on the space between general partners and limited partners across private equity, venture capital, infrastructure, and private credit. The conversation covers his career path from investment banking to direct investment strategies, including his focus on co-investments, minority equity stakes, and seating.
